explanation: Only active at the GO step, and only when the agent chooses a2 in the middle of the episode (about trials 35 to 50) right after a rewarded trial in which it chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition; then it is about 9-10. It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at every a1 choice, after an unrewarded trial (sometimes 2), after a rewarded rare transition (a2 to S1), and outside trials 35 to 50, even when a2 is rewarded there.
